definitions.explanation: One of the colored segments that form a flower. Petals protect the reproductive parts and attract pollinators.

notes:
USAGE:
{花弁|かべん} is the technical term for a petal, used in botany, science classes, and plant descriptions. In everyday speech and in poetry the word is ⟦{花|はな}びら→花びら：13988_hanabira⟧, which can also be written {花弁|はなびら}; the same kanji are read かべん only in technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花弁|かべん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{散|ち}る→散る：02075_chiru⟧: petals fall
- {花弁|かべん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: petals open
- {五枚|ごまい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花弁|かべん}: five petals

COUNTING PATTERNS:
Petals are counted with ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{一重|ひとえ}→一重：06463_hitoe⟧: single-flowered (one layer of petals)
- ⟦{八重|やえ}→八重：29805_yae⟧: double-flowered (many layers of petals)
